text.zh: 补时第 93 分钟，比分胶着，球鬼使神差地滚到你脚下，球门近在咫尺……
text.en: 93rd minute, scores level, and the ball somehow rolls to your feet with the goal gaping…

label.zh: 屏住呼吸，冷静推射死角——绝杀！
label.en: Hold your breath, slot it calmly into the corner — winner!

note.zh: 致敬阿圭罗 2012 年 93:20 的绝杀夺冠

background.zh: 2012 年英超最后一轮补时 93:20，阿圭罗为曼城打进绝杀，时隔 44 年夺得联赛冠军——解说那声「AGUEROOO」成为永恒。
background.en: On the final day of 2012, at 93:20, Agüero scored to win Manchester City their first league title in 44 years — 'AGUEROOO' echoing forever.

label.zh: 闭上眼睛大力轰门，把一切交给天意
label.en: Shut your eyes, blast it, and leave the rest to fate

label.zh: 顺势倒地骗个点球，把责任交给十二码
label.en: Go down, win a soft penalty, hand the pressure to the spot

label.zh: 横敲给空位的队友，把荣誉让给他
label.en: Square it to a teammate in space and gift him the glory
